text:
Sven Lindqvist  
Tel Aviv, Israel | +972 54 321 6789 | sven.lindqvist@email.com  

A seasoned mobile development leader with a decade of experience in crafting secure, scalable healthtech applications for startups and small enterprises. Specialized in Android and iOS architecture, with a proven ability to translate clinical requirements into user-centric mobile solutions. Consistently driven by the intersection of technical rigor and regulatory compliance, with a track record of delivering apps that balance innovation with medical-grade reliability. Currently serving as Senior Mobile Developer at VitalHealth Tech, where I oversee cross-platform EHR systems and mentor junior engineers in best practices for health data handling.  

At VitalHealth Tech, I led the design and deployment of a cross-platform EHR application that achieved 95% code reuse across iOS, Android, and web components, resulting in a 4.8 average app store rating and 15% faster time-to-market compared to prior iterations. My work there also involved integrating HIPAA-compliant data storage protocols, which reduced compliance audit preparation time by 30%. Prior to this, I spearheaded the expansion of MediSync Health’s Android app to 500k users, implementing a CI/CD pipeline that cut deployment cycles from 48 hours to under 8 hours. This pipeline, built using Jenkins and GitLab, became a cornerstone for continuous integration in the team’s development workflow.  

During my tenure at NeuroTrack Innovations, I developed the first medical device app using Flutter, achieving a 98% app store approval rate on the first submission. This project required deep collaboration with FDA-regulated hardware teams to ensure real-time data synchronization met both technical and regulatory standards. The app’s modular architecture allowed for rapid feature additions, contributing to a 25% increase in user retention within the first six months.  

**Technical Skills**  
Kotlin: Architected Android applications with clean MVVM patterns, mentoring three junior developers in writing maintainable code for health data modules.  
Flutter: Engineered a cross-platform medical app that processed over 500k patient records monthly, with zero critical crashes reported in production.  
Mobile CI/CD: Established automated testing frameworks that reduced regression bugs by 40% across all platforms.  
Android Development: Designed architecture for a telehealth app that supported 100k concurrent users, optimizing memory usage by 35% through custom ViewModel caching.  
Swift: Led iOS development for a diabetes management tool, implementing background task prioritization to ensure real-time glucose alerts.  
iOS Development: Refactored legacy codebases to adopt Apple’s latest Safe Area Layout Guidelines, improving accessibility for visually impaired users.  
TypeScript: Utilized in backend integrations for Flutter apps, ensuring type safety in API request/response handling.  
Web Performance Optimization: Reduced initial load times for hybrid apps by 20% through lazy loading and resource bundling.  

**Projects**  
- **VitalHealth EHR System**: Spearheaded cross-platform development using Flutter, integrating with multiple EMR systems. The app’s modular design allowed for rapid localization into three languages, with 92% user satisfaction in clinical trials.  
- **NeuroTrack Medical Device App**: Built a Flutter-based application for EEG data collection, achieving 98% store approval and 4.7 star ratings. The app’s real-time data visualization module was later adopted as a template for two internal tools.  
- **MediSync Telehealth Platform**: Expanded Android app to 500k users, implementing a custom push notification system that reduced latency by 50% compared to Firebase defaults.  

Master’s in Software Engineering, KTH Royal Institute of Technology, 2016  
Google Cloud Professional Android Developer Certification, 2021  
Apple Swift UI for HealthKit Certification, 2020
